feeds.title: Feed Your Soul Blog
feeds.description: I understand the pain of emotional eating and I have devoted myself to learning about emotional eating and how to release it. I know the pain of emotional eating from my own personal story as well as my clients, many friends, and acquaintances.

feeds.title: Centre For Emotional Eating Blog
feeds.description: Here at the Centre for Emotional Eating, we help people end their obsessive food thoughts and subside endless cravings by uncovering the root cause of their struggle so they feel more in control, balance their weight, and end the chaos. We've been supporting individuals to heal emotional eating since 2011. Through our unique strategies and resources, you will be guided toward a healthier relationship with food - one that is less chaotic and overwhelming.

feeds.title: Joyful Eating Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Joyful Eating Nutrition Blog by Tansy Boggon publishes articles to guide you in breaking free from food rules and diet mentality to fully experience the joy of eating without guilt or shame. Tansy is an author, university-qualified nutritionist, and mindfulness blogger inspiring you to break free from food rules and diet mentality to experience the joy of eating.

feeds.title: Rachel Molenda Blog » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Through all of the hats, Rachel has worn and will continue to wear, her mission remains the same: to help people to come home to their most authentic selves, rewrite their reality, and Do The Damn Thing. In a poll with her community when asked what that means to them, the responses included: free spirit, fearlessly authentic, lover of life, a ray of sunshine, brave, bold, 'anything is possible', inspiring, whip-smart, bad-ass leader.

feeds.title: Strong With Sarah Blag » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Read articles on emotional eating, dealing with the emotional mess, and more. Hi! My name is Sarah Pelc Graca. From my own personal experience, I've learned that there IS a secret to losing weight. The secret is finding and creating an individualized nutrition, exercise, and mindset plan that works with your life and that directly leads to results.

feeds.title: Natalie Shay Blog » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Read articles on emotional eating, and posts that will help you more about emotional eating. Hi! I'm Natalie, I would love to share more about myself to see if you feel I would be able to support you! I am a Registered Psychotherapist, life coach, and spiritual psychotherapist.

feeds.title: Xen and the Art of Mindful Eating » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Browse posts on emotional eating, dealing with emotions, and more. I spent over 30 years struggling with food, on and off diets. I hated my body and myself for binge eating, overeating, and eating emotionally. I used to believe that following food rules and restrictions was the only way. I was a chronic dieter. I have done them all.

feeds.title: Rachael Hartley Nutrition Blog » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Explore the blogs for articles on emotional eating. The Joy of Eating Blog by dietitian Rachael Hartley is your online resource for fresh and creative recipes and intuitive eating and non-diet support. Hi there! I'm Rachael, a dietitian, and nutrition therapist who really loves food. My goal is to help my clients and readers heal their relationship with food, and improve their physical and mental health with eating habits rooted in nourishment vs. deprivation.

feeds.title: A Weigh Out
feeds.description: When it comes to helping people stop binge eating and compulsive overeating, I bring a unique depth of understanding, empathy, and proven and cutting-edge tools to those I Coach. I can show you, once and for all, how to find your hope again. I've worked in this field for 30 years, as a researcher, director of a Binge Eating Disorder Treatment Center, a past President of the Binge Eating Disorder Association; BEDA.

feeds.title: Wholesome Stef
feeds.description: Stef, a certified Holistic Health Coach educates on a wholesome, plant-based diet and healthy recipes, fitness tips, wellness tips, holistic living. Wholesome Stef is a holistic lifestyle journal, showing that a wholesome life full of delicious foods, crazy workouts and self-loving practices can be fun, easy & rewarding.

feeds.title: Escape From Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Hello! I am Jessica Procini Emotional Eating Healer and the founder of Escape From Emotional Eating. I am on a mission to help and teach high achieving women how to stop overeating and find peace with food.

feeds.title: Too Much On Her Plate Blog
feeds.description: I'm a psychologist, a coach, and a writer. I'm the author of The Emotional Eating Rescue Plan for Smart, Busy Women and my approach has been featured in places like The Wall Street Journal, Good Housekeeping, Women's Health, Fitness, Self, and Weight Watcher's Magazine. My core values are compassion, open-mindedness, a passionate belief in growth and possibility, and deep respect for our humanity.

feeds.title: Modern Therapy Blog » Emotional Eating
feeds.description: Read our blog for resources related to mental wellness, emotional eating & improving your life. Modern Therapy offers the expertise of clinically licensed professionals in a way that is tailored to your unique needs.
